content_sections.heading: CERC Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 17 vacancies are available - 1 for Joint Chief (Fin), 1 for Deputy Chief (RA), 1 for Assistant Secretary (FOR), 1 for Assistant Chief (Eco), 1 for Assistant Chief (Engg), 1 for Assistant Chief (Fin), 1 for Pay and Accounts Officer, 1 for Sr. Account Officer, 4 for Private Secretary and 5 for Assistant.

Assistant Chief (Engg): Graduate Degree in Engineering with relaxation to Diploma in Engineering for members of the Central Power Engineering (Group 'A') Services. Assistant Chief (Fin): MBA in Finance or certified Chartered Accountant or certified Cost Accountant preferably with Engineering Degree. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://cercind.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for CERC Recruitment 2026 is 18th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies announced by the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) for various posts including Joint Chief, Deputy Chief, Assistant Secretary, Assistant Chief, Pay and Accounts Officer, Sr. Account Officer, Private Secretary, and Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application for CERC Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to CERC posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts announced under CERC Recruitment 2026 is 56 years. There are no specific age relaxations mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for CERC posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary for each post. They range from MBA in Finance, CA/CMA, Post Graduate degrees in Law, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, to Graduate degrees in Commerce or Engineering, and proficiency in MS Office for some positions.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the CERC Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates in CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates will be as per the Level-13 to Level-06 of the Pay Matrix, as per the 7th Central Pay Commission recommendations. Specific pay scales are detailed for each post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for CERC Recruitment 2026 primarily involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interaction. The exact details of the interaction process will be communicated by the CERC.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF for CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for CERC Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
